page.title: Chat
page.select_prompt: Pick a conversation, or start a new one with +
page.agent_link_no_access: You don't have access to chat with this agent.

input.placeholder_no_agent: Create an agent to start chatting
input.send_blocked_toast: Message not sent — you no longer have permission to use this agent
input.attachment_bind_failed_toast: Message sent, but files were not attached. Please try again in a moment.
input.project_context_unsupported: Project description won't apply — this agent's daemon needs an upgrade

message_list.no_response: The agent finished this turn without a text reply.

failure.agent_error: The agent ran into an error and couldn't finish replying. Please try again.
failure.timeout: The agent took too long and stopped before finishing. Try again, or break your request into smaller steps.
failure.codex_semantic_inactivity: The agent went idle and stopped before finishing. Please try again.
failure.runtime_offline: The agent is offline right now, so it couldn't reply. Please try again once it's back online.
failure.runtime_recovery: The agent restarted before it could finish. Please try again.
failure.skill_bundle_unavailable: The agent's skills couldn't be downloaded, so it never got started. This is usually a connection problem — please try again.
failure.provider_network: The connection to the model provider dropped before the reply finished. Check your network and try again.
failure.provider_auth_or_access: The agent's model account isn't signed in any more. Sign in again, then retry.
failure.provider_quota_limit: The agent's model account has run out of credit. Top it up or switch accounts, then retry.
failure.provider_capacity_or_rate_limit: The model provider is busy or rate-limiting this account. Please try again in a moment.
failure.context_overflow: This conversation got too long for the model. Start a new session, or break your request into smaller steps.
failure.runtime_missing_executable: The agent's CLI couldn't be found on this machine. Check that it's installed and on PATH, then retry.
failure.runtime_version_unsupported: The agent's CLI is too old for this runtime. Upgrade it, then retry.
failure.fallback: Something went wrong and the agent couldn't finish replying. Please try again.

stop_dialog.title: Stop this run?
stop_dialog.description_with_title: This will cancel the current agent task in "{{title}}". Partial output will stay in the chat.
stop_dialog.description_default: This will cancel the current agent task. Partial output will stay in the chat.

delete_dialog.title: Delete chat session
delete_dialog.description_with_title: "{{title}}" and its messages will be permanently removed. This action cannot be undone.
delete_dialog.description_default: This chat session and its messages will be permanently removed. This action cannot be undone.

applications.title: Applications
applications.heading: Choose an application and start working.
applications.description: Manage projects and service applications here. Assign people or agents, then review their results.
applications.conversation_description: Ordinary conversations are available with every person or AI you can contact. No application configuration is needed.
applications.contract_description: Submit contract files and review requirements to a configured person or AI, then follow the review and results in one session.
applications.no_providers_hint: The application remains accessible. An administrator can enable it for a person or AI before you start a review session with them.
applications.no_configurations_hint: Choose Add configuration to enable this service for a person or AI.
applications.privacy: Application configuration does not grant access to private requests, files or conversations. Pausing only stops new requests; existing requests keep their submitted rules.
applications.editor_description: Enable a person or AI to receive contract review requests. Requesters do not need their own configuration.
applications.contract_types_hint: Separate types with commas. Leave empty to accept all types.
applications.agent_setup_hint: This AI needs a configured runtime with private file download support. Current MCP-only managed runtimes cannot read contracts and cannot enable this service. Submission automatically queues processing.
applications.audience_hint: Available to members who already have permission to contact this provider.
applications.save_failed: Could not save. Check the provider, runtime and configuration version, then reload and retry. Your input is retained.
applications.unavailable: This provider has not enabled contract review, or has paused the service. Your draft is retained.
applications.auto_process: Submission automatically queues this AI to review the contract. It may wait while the AI is offline or busy.
applications.human_process: Submission is sent privately to this person for acceptance and review.
applications.legacy_agent_hint: This is an existing request. Send the AI a processing instruction in Discussion.
